curated.instructions: omr/instructions/9390-1-1.pdf and omr/instructions/9390-1-3.pdf (the tow truck, books 1 and 2); omr/instructions/9390-1-2.pdf builds the alternate buggy

functions.does: The black gear on top behind the cab is a steering knob: it turns an upright axle whose arm pushes a beam across under the front axle and steers the front wheels.
functions.source: book: book 1 sub-steps 1-6 on pages 6-7 (the knob on its upright axle and arm), book 2 steps 32-34 (the steering beam and front wheels)

functions.does: The black gear on the left of the red boom winds the winch: its axle carries the reel, whose string runs over the boom tip down to the hook, raising or lowering it.
functions.source: book: book 2 steps 26-30 (the axle, reel, string over the boom tip and hook)
functions.note: the hook's rise and fall on the string isn't expressed by the fields

functions.does: A small gear on a friction axle pin on the boom's right meshes with the gear on the winch axle, so the winch turns stiffly and holds the hook where it's left.
functions.source: inferred: book 2 steps 26 and 28 show the two small gears, one on a blue axle pin; their purpose isn't drawn

functions.does: The red boom is fixed to the back of the frame; it doesn't luff or slew.
The rear wheels roll freely on their axle.
